title: Magic Glossary
description: Schema for spell and potion YAML entries in the HP Fan site

category.description: Determines the URL base path: /Harrypedia/magic/spells/ or /Harrypedia/magic/potions/

title.description: Primary route name. For spells this is typically the incantation (e.g. 'Expecto Patronum'). For potions this is the potion name.

name.description: Alternate name that gets its own route pointing to the same entry. For spells this is typically the common name (e.g. 'Patronus Charm'). Omit if the same as title.

content.description: Markdown body rendered as the page content. Typically includes ## Description and ## Found in sections.
